name: Cream Toast
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: piece of butter the size of an egg
ingredients.originalText: a piece of butter the size of an egg

instructions.text: Heat a pint of milk to boiling
Add a piece of butter the size of an egg
Stir a tablespoonful of flour smoothly into a cup of rich cream
Add some of the boiling milk to this
Heat it gradually and prevent the flour from lumping
Stir into the boiling milk and let it cook a few moments
After taking from the fire stir in a beaten egg
Strain the mixture on to toast lightly buttered

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Heat a pint of milk to boiling
2. Add a piece of butter the size of an egg
3. Stir a tablespoonful of flour smoothly into a cup of rich cream
4. Add some of the boiling milk to this
5. Heat it gradually and prevent the flour from lumping
6. Stir into the boiling milk and let it cook a few moments
7. Salt to taste
8. After taking from the fire stir in a beaten egg
9. Strain the mixture on to toast lightly buttered
